name: lossmask_patch_v1
purpose: optional per-action loss mask for the July-control trainer (1 = label ignored); used by the overnight delete arms whose wrong inserts are masked
import_chain: pretrain_resttraj.patched.py -> data.training_resttraj_bucketed_dataset -> reviser.data.training_resttraj_bucketed_dataset -> reviser.data.raining_resttraj_bucketed_dataset; collator imported directly from reviser.data.resttraj_pretrain_collator

raining_resttraj_bucketed_dataset.py.change: loads shards/rest_lossmask_shardK.npy if present (uint8, aligned with rest_tokens) and adds sample['loss_mask']; no RNG use, no change when the file is absent

resttraj_pretrain_collator.py.change: after prefix masking, labels[i] = -100 where sample['loss_mask'][i] == 1

test: tests/test_overnight_variants.py::test_lossmask_patch_identity_and_masking (no mask file: batches and collated tensors identical to the original; mask file: same batch order, labels -100 exactly at prefix + masked actions). Passed 2026-10-07 05:21Z in WSL /opt/venv (CPU).
note: masked labels still count in tokens_processed (attention_mask sum), so the 83,866,148-token budget is the same input-token budget as every other arm; the loss mean is over unmasked labels
